run-external-review uses an explicit host transport registry; unknown/cursor/grok are capability_limited, never remapped to Claude.
Non-fake launch with null launch_command is capability_limited; launch_receipted requires a pid.
consume binds result.wi, requires event_status=success + artifacts + no failing ACs before closed_pass.
Continuation children fail closed when the ledger is unreadable.
Cursor/Grok Stop adapters preserve core exit status; missing/crash is exit 2.
